links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT answers across repeated generations of the same question
links.effect: High consistency of answers across 60 repeated generations (85.44%); no significant differences in consistency by question difficulty.
links.quote: The answers generated by ChatGPT showed high consistency (85.44%).

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT answers to endodontic questions versus expert answers
links.effect: Average accuracy 57.33%; significant differences by difficulty, with lower accuracy for easier questions.
links.quote: In terms of answer accuracy, ChatGPT achieved an average accuracy of 57.33%.

screen.reason: Evaluates the consistency and accuracy of ChatGPT in answering endodontic questions across multiple runs compared to expert answers, without testing any specific guardrail or deployment practice.
